Welcome! My name is Jill, and I am a Licensed Veterinary Technician and a Mom of 3 crazy dogs and 2 cats and too many chickens to count :)  I have in-clinic  experience in busy veterinary clinics & hospitals.  My goal with this channel is to be a helpful place of information and comfort for you, the pet parents!  It can be hard to be a pet owner and know what to do or how to react in a situation.  
  
If you haven’t already, please subscribe, like, and share my videos to help other pet parents get the information that they might need!    Remember, I’m here for you. You’re here for your pet!  
        ~Jill
I AM NOT A REPLACEMENT FOR GOOD QUALITY VETERINARY CARE!  PLEASE DO YOUR YEARLY PET WELLNESS EXAMS AND FOLLOW THEIR RECOMMENDATIONS FOR YOUR PET!
If you would like to reach out to me, please email me at furkidsandcoffee@gmail.com
